name: Peripheral Battery
author: fredde
description: Battery for your mouse and other wireless peripherals in the Omarchy bar: a charging bolt on the USB cable, the level on 2.4 GHz or Bluetooth. Reads Glorious and HyperX over HID directly, plus anything UPower, openrazer or HeadsetControl sees.

barWidget.description: Your mouse's battery in the bar, with a bolt while it charges. Click for every peripheral's level.

schema.label: Bar device
schema.description: Device id to show in the bar. Leave empty for the first mouse found; clicking a device in the panel fills this in.

schema.label: Show the percentage next to the icon
Hide the widget when no device is found
Notify when a device runs low
Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Plugging or unplugging a device refreshes right away regardless.
